part.text:
Confirmed: the baseline has the same 8 pre-existing environment errors plus 3 trim failures. With my fix, all 3 trim failures pass and only the pre-existing errors remain.

## Summary

Fixed `Str::trim` regression where the null byte (`\x00`) was no longer stripped, breaking parity with PHP's native `trim()` (src/Illuminate/Support/Str.php):

1. **`Str::trim`** (src/Illuminate/Support/Str.php:1507): added `\x{0000}` to the trim-character regex pattern, and added explicit `$code === 0x00` checks to both the start and end scanning loops of the ASCII fast path.
2. **`Str::ltrim`** (src/Illuminate/Support/Str.php:1667): added `\x{0000}` to the character class.
3. **`Str::rtrim`** (src/Illuminate/Support/Str.php:1683): added `\x{0000}` to the character class.

Verified: `Str::trim(" \x00 ")` now returns `""` (matching `trim()`), the targeted `testTrim`/`testLtrim`/`testRtrim` tests in `SupportStrTest` and `SupportStringableTest` pass (104+ assertions), and the full `tests/Support` suite shows no new failures versus baseline.
